dispatch.comment: generate: the dispatcher files are written by scripts/gen_dispatch.py from the bytes. prelude_gas, entry_gas and memory_words are checked against the bytes there.
layout_doc: Storage layout, read off the bytecode (see docs/MAP.md):
- `crowdsale` in the low 160 bits of slot 3.

paths.comment: decide_equivalent: a branch whose condition equals an earlier one up to ISZERO pairs and reads of slots is decided by it (no vacuous path).

supply.comment: mode delta: mint adds to a balance and never writes totalSupply_ (slot 1), so the plain invariant is not kept; each function gets the exact change of D = sum of balances - slot 1. fixed_slots: slots no successful call changes (totalSupply_, crowdsale).

name.doc: name(): no value; returns the ABI encoding of the string "Quant" (offset 32, length 5, the five bytes then zeros), a constant of the code; reads no slot, writes nothing and logs nothing.

symbol.doc: symbol(): no value; returns the ABI encoding of the string "QNT" (offset 32, length 3, the three bytes then zeros), a constant of the code; reads no slot, writes nothing and logs nothing.

decimals.doc: decimals(): no value; returns 18, a constant of the code; reads no slot, writes nothing and logs nothing.

DECIMAL_ZEROS.doc: DECIMAL_ZEROS(): no value; returns 10^18, a constant of the code; reads no slot, writes nothing and logs nothing.

totalSupply.doc: totalSupply(): no value; returns `totalSupply_` (slot 1); writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

crowdsale.doc: crowdsale(): no value; returns the low 160 bits of slot 3; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

balanceOf.doc: balanceOf(a): no value (no check of the call data size: a missing argument reads as 0); returns `balances[a]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

allowance.doc: allowance(owner, spender): no value; returns `allowed[owner][spender]`; writes nothing and logs nothing.
ensures: ∀ k, storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

approve.doc: approve(spender, value) from the caller `owner`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write (no check that `spender` is not 0, no check of the old allowance). Then: returns 1; `allowed[owner][spender]` is `value`; `totalSupply_` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, value).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

increaseApproval.doc: increaseApproval(spender, added) from the caller `owner`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, no overflow of `allowed[owner][spender] + added` (an overflow ends in INVALID, not REVERT). Then: returns 1; the allowance is the old word plus `added`; `totalSupply_` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, new allowance).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k
s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL {owner} {spender} (wordBytes (add (allowance message state {owner} {spender}) {added})))

decreaseApproval.doc: decreaseApproval(spender, subtracted) from the caller `owner`, on both success paths (subtracted above the old allowance: the allowance becomes 0; else it is the old word minus `subtracted`). Success needs: no value, a frame that may write. Then: returns 1; the allowance is the old one minus `subtracted`, stopping at 0 (natural number subtraction); `totalSupply_` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Approval(owner, spender, new allowance).
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {owner} 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k
s.substate.logs = substate.logs.push (log3 message.currentTarget APPROVAL {owner} {spender} (wordBytes (allowance message s.state {owner} {spender})))

transfer.doc: transfer(to, amount) from the caller `from`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, `to` not 0, `amount <= balances[from]`, and (when `to` is not `from`) no overflow of `balances[to]`. Then: returns 1; `balances[from]` is the old word minus `amount` and `balances[to]` the old word plus `amount` (when `to = from` the balance is unchanged); `totalSupply_` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Transfer(from, to, amount).
ensures: {to} ≠ {from} → (balance message s.state {from}).toNat = (balance message state {from}).toNat - {amount}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {to}).toNat = (balance message state {to}).toNat + {amount}.toNat
{to} = {from} → balance message s.state {from} = balance message state {from}
totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {from} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {to} 0 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

transferFrom.doc: transferFrom(from, to, amount) by the caller `spender`. Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, `to` not 0, `amount <= balances[from]`, `amount <= allowed[from][spender]`, and (when `to` is not `from`) no overflow of `balances[to]`. Then: returns 1; the balances move as in transfer (unchanged when `to = from`); `allowed[from][spender]` is the old word minus `amount`; `totalSupply_` and every other slot keep their word; exactly one log, Transfer(from, to, amount) (no Approval log).
ensures: {to} ≠ {from} → (balance message s.state {from}).toNat = (balance message state {from}).toNat - {amount}.toNat ∧ (balance message s.state {to}).toNat = (balance message state {to}).toNat + {amount}.toNat
{to} = {from} → balance message s.state {from} = balance message state {from}
totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {from} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {to} 0 → k ≠ mapSlot {spender} (mapSlot {from} 2) → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

mint.doc: mint(to, amount). Success needs: no value, a frame that may write, the caller equal to the address in slot 3 (`crowdsale`), and no overflow of `balances[to]` (an overflow ends in INVALID). There is no cap and no mint-finished flag. Then: returns nothing (STOP); `balances[to]` is the old word plus `amount`; `totalSupply_` (slot 1) is NOT changed, nor any other slot; exactly one log, Transfer(0, to, amount).
requires: sender message = bitwiseAnd (1461501637330902918203684832716283019655932542975 : U256) (storageAt state message.currentTarget 3)
ensures: totalSupply message s.state = totalSupply message state
∀ k, k ≠ mapSlot {to} 0 → storageAt s.state message.currentTarget k = storageAt state message.currentTarget k

readable_opts.comment: more rewrite rules for the readable proofs: the read of an address at offset 0 of a slot (DIV by 1), the number of the word 0. several_paths same_claims: a function with several success paths proves the same claims on each path (the default closes, on each path, the cases that the path excludes).

sanity.comment: The argument words of the witness call of each function (scripts/gen_sanity.py): address arguments not 0, amounts 0. mint and the first path of decreaseApproval need a state that is not all 0: their witnesses are hand-written in Sanity/Moves.lean.

axioms.comment: names: theorems of the dispatcher files, checked before the generated ones; after: theorems of files that import the generated ones; imports: the modules Test/Axioms.lean imports.
